comparison.objective: Install the correct end and mid clamps at six solar-panel rail positions.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp selection, placement, and seating rather than impact-controlled notch fracture and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Correct clamp type seated level at each position; no hammer strike, insert retention, or containment requirement.
comparison.reason: This is repeated fastening by clamp placement, not post-installation tang removal. No specs or numeric seating/damage thresholds are provided.
